reason: Amber Protocol is a repository-local governance CLI for planning, gating, verifying, documenting, and handing off AI-assisted engineering work without executing project workflows.

summaries.zh: Amber Protocol 是一个面向 AI 辅助工程的仓库本地治理工具，用于规划、审批、验证、记录和交接开发工作。
summaries.en: Amber Protocol is a repository-local governance tool for planning, approving, verifying, documenting, and handing off AI-assisted engineering work.

capabilities: Reads repository state and governance files
Creates local governance, planning, approval, verification, and handoff artifacts
Produces dry-run plans, reports, and recommended next commands
Does not execute project commands, dynamic workflows, live subagents, or external systems according to the README
